instruction: How can I track my order
response: You can track your order by logging into your account and visiting the Order History page, where you'll find real-time tracking information.

instruction: I want to cancel my order
response: To cancel your order, go to Order History, select the order, and click Cancel Order. Cancellations are only possible before the item ships.
We offer a full refund within 30 days of purchase as long as the item is unused and in its original packaging. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

instruction: How do I reset my password
response: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email, and follow the reset link we send you. The link expires after 24 hours.

instruction: How can I contact customer support
response: You can reach our support team via live chat on our website, by emailing support@example.com, or by calling our toll-free number 24/7.

instruction: Can I change my shipping address after ordering
response: You can update your shipping address within 1 hour of placing the order from the Order History page, as long as it hasn't shipped yet.

instruction: What payment methods do you accept
response: We accept all major credit and debit cards, PayPal, and Apple Pay. Some regions also support cash on delivery.
